groups.label: Body / spine / acromion
groups.description: Extraarticular scapular body, spine, or process fracture patterns.

variants.label: Body simple
variants.description: Simple scapular body fracture with acceptable glenopolar relationship.

variants.label: Body multifragmentary
variants.description: Comminuted body fracture with potential medialization or angular deformity.

variants.label: Acromion / spine
variants.description: Scapular spine or acromion fracture affecting shoulder suspension.

treatments.label: Nonoperative treatment
treatments.main_indications: Most minimally displaced scapular body fractures without shoulder girdle instability.

treatments.label: Posterior approach fixation
treatments.main_indications: Marked displacement, angular deformity, or floating shoulder pattern requiring restoration of scapular anatomy.

treatments.label: Superior acromion approach
treatments.main_indications: Displaced acromion fracture threatening subacromial space or deltoid function.

groups.label: Neck / superior shoulder suspensory complex
groups.description: Scapular neck fracture patterns that may affect glenoid alignment and shoulder suspension.

variants.label: Anatomic neck
variants.description: Fracture isolating the glenoid from the scapular body.

variants.label: Surgical neck
variants.description: Neck fracture with maintained articular block but altered glenoid position.

variants.label: Floating shoulder pattern
variants.description: Neck fracture combined with clavicle or ligamentous injury affecting the shoulder ring.

treatments.label: Posterior neck fixation
treatments.main_indications: Displaced neck fracture with glenoid malalignment or unstable shoulder suspension.

treatments.label: Floating shoulder sequence
treatments.main_indications: Combined shoulder-girdle injury requiring staged clavicle and scapula decision-making.

treatments.label: Sabercut approach
treatments.main_indications: Selected superior or posterior-superior scapular exposure requirements.

groups.label: Articular glenoid
groups.description: Glenoid rim or fossa fracture involving the shoulder joint surface.

variants.label: Anterior rim
variants.description: Anterior glenoid rim fracture associated with instability.

variants.label: Posterior rim
variants.description: Posterior rim fracture or posterior glenoid deficiency.

variants.label: Glenoid fossa
variants.description: Transverse or multifragmentary articular glenoid fracture.

treatments.label: Deltopectoral approach
treatments.main_indications: Anterior glenoid rim or coracoid-associated exposure.

treatments.label: Posterior approach
treatments.main_indications: Posterior rim, transverse glenoid, or posterior column articular fractures.

treatments.label: Arthroscopic entry points
treatments.main_indications: Selected articular assessment or minimally invasive adjuncts.
